specs.name: vlx-geo-geoshape-empty-data

specs.name: wordcloud-empty-data
specs.why: by design: an empty-data wordcloud; real vega's wordcloud transform needs a canvas that the Node oracle lacks, so the words of a cloud are compared in Chromium by wordcloud-vs-vega.test.ts and this entry pins that no words means no marks
